description: This file implements the Login page component for a React frontend application. It manages a multi-step login flow including email input, organization selection, and password submission. It interacts with external APIs for fetching user organizations and performing login, handles state for form inputs, loading indicators, and error messages, and performs navigation based on login success or specific error conditions.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles form submission to fetch organizations for the provided email using getUserOrganizations API.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles login form submission, performs login API call, manages navigation upon success or specific error conditions.
